The emperor's main residence. The octagonal Mussaman Burj tower looks out toward the Yamuna River and is where the Emperor used to appear before the public each morning.
The memorial to Mahatma Gandhi at the site of his cremation. Check for closure dates/security checks around national holidays/Gandhi's death anniversary.
The residence of the emperor's main wife.

The memorial to Rajiv Gandhi, the sixth Prime Minister of India.

The memorial to Indira Gandhi, the third Prime Minister of India. The site is marked by a large monolithic rock of iron ore, symbolizing the epithet "Iron Lady of India". The rock was sourced from one of the Sundergarh mines of Odisha.
The memorial to Jawaharlal Nehru, the first Prime Minister of India.

Built completely of marble, this is where the emperor received special visitors.
Once a grand garden full of fountains and streams, now sadly all dry, only dry channels and acres of green grass remain. Near here will you find the Sawan Pavilion.
The memorial to Lal Bahadur Shastri, the second Prime Minister of India.
The memorial to Jagjivan Ram, the fourth Deputy Prime Minister of India.
